unit_definition_as_provided.definition: x-axis is labeled as 'Day' (days 0–4) on the plot image.
y-axis labeled 'Relative expression (A.U.)' on the plot image. (Caption defines A.U. as 'arbitrary units' but see replicates note below.)
Data/replicates note from caption: 'Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments for (C, F, G).'

justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: x-axes are fluorescence channels/markers (e.g., PDGFRα-BV421, NKX2-5-GFP) showing intensity but no units (e.g., arbitrary fluorescence units) are indicated on the axis labels.

y-axes are fluorescence channels/markers (e.g., SOX17-Tom, CD235-APC) showing intensity but no units or scale (e.g., arbitrary fluorescence units or channel units/log scale) are provided on the axes or in the caption.

unit_definition_as_provided.definition: x-axis corresponds to inhibitor treatments/concentrations; the figure (E) and the strip above plots indicate concentrations with μM (e.g., 5 μM SB, 0.6 μM SB, 0.06 μM DMH1, 0.5 μM DMH1).

y-axis shows 'Positive cells (%)' (proportion of positive cells) as indicated on the plot image. Data/replicates note from caption: 'Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments for (C, F, G).'
x-axis corresponds to inhibitor treatments/concentrations; concentrations are indicated in the figure labeling (μM) matching panel E.

y-axis shows 'Positive cells (%)' (proportion of positive cells) on the plot image. Data/replicates note from caption: 'Data are represented as mean ± SEM (n = 3–4) independent biological experiments for (C, F, G).'
y-axis labeled 'Normalized read counts' on the plot image (RNA-seq quantification).
Data/replicates note from caption: 'The boxplots follow standard Tukey representations (n = 3 independent biological experiments) and are coloured by the lineage markers.'
Color scale/legend indicates 'log2FC' / Z-score normalized log2 fold-change differences as stated in the figure: 'Expression levels are represented as Z-score normalized log2 FC differences.'
